author: Leon Made This / s010s

name.zh: Spyroceras · UMUT PM18493 不完整气室壳

description.en: Evidence-informed incomplete phragmocone fragment, Spyroceras melolineatum holotype UMUT PM18493. Rear and closed mineral fracture faces inferred. Nominal 89mm preserved length is conditional print-scale estimate (at least ±15% uncertainty), not exact specimen measurement. No apex, terminal aperture, body chamber or soft animal is reconstructed.
description.zh: 据文献制作的不完整气室壳残片；背面与矿化断面推定，89毫米为至少±15%不确定性的条件印刷比例估计。 不复原壳顶、终末壳口、住室或软体动物。

scientific_scope_departure: Original provisional genus-level ring-ribbed shell direction is narrowed to one identified incomplete phragmocone. Apex, aperture, body chamber and animal are absent; no intact shell or historical-byte recovery is claimed.

reference_credits.title: Niko (1996), Pseudorthoceratid cephalopods from the Early Devonian Fukuji Formation of Gifu Prefecture, Central Japan
reference_credits.use: consulted-only; no reference media, mesh or texture incorporated
